h1: Custom Quilted Outerwear for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom quilted outerwear with your logo. Perfect for workwear or team uniforms. Fast turnaround on bulk orders.
introHtml: Quilted outerwear adds a layer of warmth and professional polish that stands up to cold conditions on job sites or outdoor events. Unlike standard fleece or softshell jackets, quilted vests and coats offer structured insulation without bulk, making them ideal for layering over uniform shirts or hoodies. Choose from classic styles like the Carhartt Duck Vest or modern hybrid jackets that combine quilted panels with stretch fleece for mobility. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing on the chest or back for clear brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom quilted outerwear with embroidered logo on a men's quilted vest
